changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cart DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cart_legacy_or_bound_scope

ALTER TABLE cart ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cart_legacy_or_bound_scope CHECK ( ( provider IS NULL AND routing_scope_key IS NULL AND merchant_integration_id IS NULL AND external_merchant_id IS NULL AND merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND merchant_domain IS NOT NULL ) OR ( provider IS NOT NULL AND routing_scope_key IS NOT NULL AND merchant_integration_id IS NOT NULL AND merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND merchant_domain IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(routing_domain, merchant_domain) IS NOT NULL ) OR ( provider IS NOT NULL AND routing_scope_key IS NOT NULL AND merchant_integration_id IS NULL AND merchant_id IS NULL AND external_merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND routing_domain IS NOT NULL ) )

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE agent_artifact_reference artifact SET payload_json = jsonb_set( artifact.payload_json::jsonb - 'merchantDomain', '{merchantOrigin}', to_jsonb(cart.merchant_domain), true )::text, label = 'Cart at ' || cart.merchant_domain FROM cart WHERE artifact.artifact_type = 'CART' AND artifact.cart_id = cart.id AND cart.merchant_domain IS NOT NULL;
UPDATE agent_artifact_reference artifact SET payload_json = ( artifact.payload_json::jsonb - 'merchantDomain' - 'merchantOrigin' )::text, label = CASE WHEN artifact.label LIKE 'Cart at %' THEN 'Cart' ELSE artifact.label END FROM cart WHERE artifact.artifact_type = 'CART' AND artifact.cart_id = cart.id AND cart.merchant_domain IS NULL;
